lines: Crypto is money recorded on a public ledger that nobody can quietly edit
scenes.sub: You'll open an exchange account, buy a little crypto, move it into a wallet only you control, and make your first practice DeFi transaction, all with a small amount and a checklist.

scenes.title: Words you'll need
scenes.vo: Blockchain: a shared ledger kept by thousands of computers. Wallet: an app or device holding the keys that control your crypto. Seed phrase: 12 to 24 words that are your wallet. Never share. Exchange: a company that swaps your money for crypto. Gas: the network fee for a transaction.
scenes.cap: Blockchain: a shared ledger kept by thousands of computers. Wallet: an app or device holding the keys that control your crypto. Seed phrase: 12–24 words that are your wallet. Never share. Exchange: a company that swaps your money for crypto. Gas: the network fee for a transaction.

scenes.title: Before you start
items: A phone, a computer, ID for KYC, a bank account

scenes.title: The mastery ladder
scenes.vo: Beginner: Can explain blockchain, wallet and seed phrase in plain words. Practitioner: Has a secured exchange account and a restore-tested wallet. Master: Completes the whole Day-1 Setup Kit and can coach a friend through it.
